node.statement: Transported-source comparison on the P-corner. For Y=Co_P X and X_0=v^{-1}(Y), the two-sided norm bound for v gives ||X_0||<=(1-delta)^(-1)||Y||. Applying delta-multiplicativity twice to E_aa X_0 E_bb in M_r, and using lem-compcb-corner-algebra for the universal product/associator bounds in S_P, gives ||v(E_aa X_0 E_bb)-(R_a dot Y) dot R_b||<=C_2*e||X||. Replacing the two compressed products by ambient products gives ||T_ab X-R_a(YR_b)||<=C_3*e||X||. All source matrix factors have norm one, so C_2,C_3 are independent of r,a,b.
